page.layout: One page of running text in one column; one marginal note in the left margin, beside the line "grapho".

main_text.p: apertos, simplicibus & parvulis, imò ut ait Paulus, stultis hujus seculi proponi: non enim hic ingenij acumine sed lumi-ne spiritus obscura dijudicantur. Lumen autem illud ijs infundetur qui Mandata Dei servabunt, quoniam testante Psalmo-Psal.iii.10.grapho, bonus probusque voluntatis divinæ intellectus, penes eos est, qui se eisdem obedientes præstant: præcipuè tamen preces ad hoc conferunt, nam cui deest sapientia, à Deo illam petat monet Iacobus: qui Spiritum Sanctum desiderat, habet à quo accipiat, postquam Christus nobis ad Patrem accessum paravit, qui ex promisso filij sui, largus est in omnes invocantes se, & Spiritum suum Sanctum dabit postulantibus eum.

Assidui ergo sint, in orationibus laborantes, ut in omnibus Dei Spiritus illos dirigat, qui data cognitione præceptorum divinorum, ipsorum simul voluntatem divinæ subjiciet & obedientem reddet, ne arbor pulchro foliorum virore arridens, umbramque haud insuavem defatigatis præbens, ideo tamen maledictionem incurrat, quia fructum quum visitatur (tempore licet maximè intempestivo) creatori suo non suppeditat. Discant itaque & bonis operibus præesse, talibus videlicet, quæ ex s-[?]

page.notes: The printed text at the foot is cut off at a line end ("ex s-"); the rest of the word continues on the next page. The reading of the first letter after "ex" is doubtful. The margin reference "Psal.iii.10." is printed in a slightly larger, italic type and is rendered here with a plain s as required. Ligatures æ are transcribed as printed where the scan shows them; some are uncertain.
